protocol_kind: prospective self-report + binary prediction scoring, not causal retrocausality experiment
hypothesis: H1: self-reported feeling of foreknowledge predicts prespecified objectively assessable binary outcomes above prospectively fixed base-rate and ordinary predictive controls
null: H0: no improvement over predeclared baselines after accounting for reporting, selection, and multiple comparisons
scope: Illustrative self-tracking study design, not external preregistration, blind study or clinical measurement
unit_of_analysis: One pre-event, binary, time-bounded, inspectable outcome prediction
required_before_outcome: predefined sample size and stopping rule
hash or version identifying fixed content
common_failures: post hoc change of threshold or target event

statistics.primary: mean Brier loss across all prospectively eligible binary forecasts; smaller is better
statistics.baseline: Must be set from external training/base-rate data before target outcomes; 0.5 in app is a noncalibrated toy comparison only
statistics.interpretation: A fixed chance or accuracy benchmark alone cannot establish effect or causality
statistics.multiplicity: Specify subgroup and multiple-testing adjustments in a subsequent locked execution plan; no post hoc new primary outcomes
statistics.null_test: Compare paired losses to predeclared calibrated conventional predictor on held-out data; confidence intervals and power must be specified before use
statistics.minimum_future_requirements: No execution/sample-size, power or effect threshold was frozen at repository creation. Therefore no confirmatory experiment is presently ready.

freeze.local_behavior: app prevents ordinary UI edits to frozen fields; browser storage, device time and app source are mutable
freeze.external_custody: To support actual temporal priority, commit JSON to independent append-only log / signed external timestamp before event
freeze.amendments: Any correction after freeze creates a new record with amendedFrom pointer; original archived externally must remain unchanged
freeze.not_guaranteed: Browser-only local freeze is not a tamper-proof, third-party timestamp

claim_tree.parent: FAIL if any required child FAIL; PASS only when all required child PASS; otherwise UNRESOLVED
claim_tree.interpretation: Logical workflow statuses, not actual theorem-proof checking

postselection_toy.data: synthetic deterministic x bins and preassigned labels
postselection_toy.demonstration: reveal or hide subgroup labels without changing raw marginal histogram
postselection_toy.exclusion: not simulation of an actual quantum eraser or backward causation

privacy: No health records, invasive inference, data uploads or telemetry; user-controlled browser storage and manual JSON export/import
stop_rule: Stop the specific prospective predictive-skill claim if adequate precommitted sample fails the predefined improvement threshold. The current project has not fixed a sample size or started a confirmatory run.
physical_interpretation: No operationally demonstrated backward-in-time signaling; any future predictive advantage would require ordinary mechanisms to be compared before retrocausal interpretation.
approval_needed: Prospective research involving participants must be separately designed and ethically reviewed when applicable.
